(1) similarity-based methods that combine three types of similarities outperform methods that use fewer similarity types; and (2) predictive performance of similarity-based methods is sensitive to low similarity between drug structures and sequences of their targets and to several extrinsic characteristics of drugs, drug targets and drug profiles.
similarity-based predictors of DPIs can be grouped based on three types and their combinations, and that a predictor combining all three types achieves the highest predictive performance.
